historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Police Department's denial of a permit for a place of entertainment at 3309 Mission Street in further hearing, with stipulations on a plaque showing the maximum occupant load of 49 persons, an outward-opening rear door, illuminated exit signs, and anchored stairs with a handrail at the rear exit.
The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the S.F. Police Department and denied the Billiard Parlor and Mechanical Amusement Device permits for La Campana at 3309 Mission Street.
La Campana was at 3309 Mission Street.
